claimChanges.claimText: ChulaGENIE is listed for Chulalongkorn University in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.
Chulalongkorn guidance prohibits uploading organizational confidential information or personal information into AI systems without consent from the concerned individuals.
Chulalongkorn University supports students and staff developing understanding and appropriate use of AI tools.

Chulalongkorn guidance says users who use AI tools in a task should cite and clearly state the scope of use; concealing AI-tool use is treated as an ethical violation that may be penalized under relevant rules.

For teaching and assessment, Chulalongkorn guidance says instructors should understand selected AI tools, define course-level scope and directions for use, and adjust evaluation when AI use is allowed.
